products.title: The Exploding Pudding
products.summary: Dr Wobble made six test puddings and three of them exploded. Student A has the recipe cards, Student B has the lab notes and the results, and together a pair works out what makes the pudding explode. Neither sheet solves it alone.

facts.label: Includes
facts.value: Teacher notes, Student A and Student B sheets, answer key
